text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT created: P0 - inference error rate and 5xx spike in eu-west-1. Pager sent to @oncall-amber and @sre_dan. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-134

oncall-amber: ack — taking pager. will post timeline here.

sre_dan: I'm on. quick check - error spike started ~03:12Z in metrics, can someone confirm if any deploys landed around then?

enginfra-oliver: no deploys from infra at 03:10-03:20. I did push a change to fluentd sampling config at 03:09Z to reduce log shipper load (rollout to eu-west-1 only). rolling back now.

oncall-amber: Copy. Hypotheses: H1: downstream model process flapping; H2: log sampling change hid root logs; H3: routing/NGINX misconfig. We'll collect evidence.

pm_leah: heads-up — customer HelenCorp on eu-west has active workflows. CX alerted, keep me posted on impact so we can coordinate comms.

logbot: alert: fluentd-sampler changed sampling_rate from 1.0 -> 0.05 for namespace inference-eu at 2026-03-15T03:09:40Z by enginfra-oliver.

observability-kate: seeing dashboards: 5xx rate for inference-prod-eu increased x6 starting 03:12Z. But some logs missing for hosts i-0a*, i-0b*; query returning 0 rows for those hosts for 03:10-03:20.

sre_dan: running ad-hoc query against raw logs (Elasticsearch):
```
GET /logs-*/_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "filter": [
        {"term": {"service": "inference"}},
        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "2026-03-15T03:05:00Z","lte": "2026-03-15T03:25:00Z"}}}
      ]
    }
  },
  "size": 5
}
```

sre_dan: result: majority of messages are present from us-east hosts, but eu-west hosts show a gap starting 03:09:40. matches logbot change time.

oncall-amber: Oliver, can you confirm rollback status and whether that would recover logs historically?

enginfra-oliver: rollback triggered at 03:22Z, config reverted to sampling_rate=1.0. Note: changing sampling only affects future ingestion, not re-ingesting missing logs unless we re-run shipper replay. I can start a replay for affected hosts if we want.

sre_dan: For timeline building:
- 03:09:40Z fluentd sampling change applied (enginfra-oliver)
- 03:12Z first metric spike (5xx) reported
- 03:14Z partial alerts from health-checks
- 03:18Z incident created/pager fired
- 03:22Z sampling rollback initiated

observability-kate: important: metric spike aligns with sampling change but that could be correlation not causation. We should check request routing logs (NGINX) to see if upstream returned errors or if our model containers returned >500.

sre_dan: grabbed a short sample from application metrics (Prometheus):
```
# HELP app_inference_errors_total
# TYPE app_inference_errors_total counter
app_inference_errors_total{env="eu-west",pod="inference-xyz"} 347
app_inference_errors_total{env="us-east",pod="inference-abc"} 12
```

sre_dan: That suggests errors originated at app level in eu-west, not only missing logs. But we need traces.

enginfra-oliver: checking model host health - CPU spiked on 3 nodes at 03:11-03:13, and OOM killer recorded on host i-0b94 at 03:12:07. Logged, but sampling may have prevented full stack traces from being shipped.

oncall-amber: H1 stronger now: app/process instability. Action list: 1) take affected nodes out of LB (oliver) 2) begin replay/log reingest for 03:05-03:25 window (oliver) 3) escalate to model team for debugging (pm_leah to coordinate) 4) notify customers impacted (jess).

enginfra-oliver: removing nodes from LB now: commands:`kubectl cordon inference-node-1 && kubectl drain inference-node-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then scale up a replacement autoscaled node. Doing rolling now.

customer-success-jess: copying list of customers with requests to eu-west: HelenCorp, ShopTide, Fizzly. HelenCorp has active workflows; will open support ticket and link to incident.

pm_leah: Leah here — Model team joining: @mike-models and @tara-models. Mike: can you check model memory usage and container logs (if any) for 03:10-03:15?

sre_dan: while we wait on full logs, here's a hypothesis tracker I started in-thread: H1 (process OOM) -> evidence: host OOM recorded, app error spike, missing logs due to sampling. H2 (bad model weights) -> evidence: none yet. H3 (traffic surge) -> evidence: no traffic increase in global metrics, only error rate increased.

mike-models: quick check — model memory graphs show a transient spike on those pods around 03:11 that coincide with GC thrashing, but we need full container logs. If logs are missing, can we attach at node level?

enginfra-oliver: we do have local journalctl on the nodes. pulling /var/log/docker logs now. starting replay of shipped logs -> will reingest to a temporary index for forensic queries. ETA ~ 20m.

observability-kate: dashboard note — the main 5xx panel had a downsampling applied (rollup 1m). I'm creating a raw-panel (per-request) to show host-level progression. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/d/abcd/realtime-eu?panel=raw

sre_dan: also toggled transient tracing sampling to 100% for inference-eu to capture traces for next 30m: `tracectl set-sampling inference-eu 1.0 --duration 30m`

oncall-amber: good. anyone seeing customer-facing errors in support channels? @customer-success-jess?

customer-success-jess: HelenCorp reported 503s since 03:13Z via support channel. I've posted a temp status note to HelenCorp and told them we're investigating and will follow up.

enginfra-oliver: replay started at 03:45Z, writing to index logs-replay-eu-2026-03-15. First batch will be searchable in ~5m.

sre_dan: evidence update after replay sample: the container logs contain repeated stack traces: `RuntimeError: model worker OOM at forward pass` across multiple pods at 03:11:56Z. That aligns with OOM on host.

pm_leah: Model team action: immediate mitigations — reduce batch size on inference containers, pin a graceful restart policy, and push a fix to avoid OOM on that model variant. Mike/Tara please coordinate PR.

mike-models: reducing in-proc batch size via config update now. Will monitor error rate after restart.

observability-kate: dashboard raw-panel now shows error rate dropping after nodes drained and batch size change. 5xx rate returned to baseline by 03:38Z.

noncall-amber: summary for timeline/TTR:
- Root cause (prelim): model-worker OOMs on eu-west hosts after model execution, exacerbated by suppressed logs due to sampling change.
- Contributing factor: accidental sampling change at 03:09 that hid early signs and slowed RCA.
- Mitigations taken: reverted sampling at 03:22Z, drained and replaced impacted nodes 03:25-03:35Z, reduced model batch size and restarted pods 03:30-03:36Z, log replay for forensic evidence completed 03:50Z, tracing sampling increased 03:20-03:50Z.

pm_leah: recommended follow-ups: 1) enforce deploy checklist for log-config changes + pre-rollout smoke tests 2) add alert for sudden drop in log ingestion per-host 3) postmortem + customer comms draft.

customer-success-jess: I've sent HelenCorp a post-incident note and will follow up with a more formal RCA once we have the postmortem.

sre_dan: open item: need retention of the replay index for 7 days for forensic QA. Oliver can you confirm retention policy for temporary replays?

enginfra-oliver: setting index lifecycle to 7d for logs-replay-eu-2026-03-15 now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT status changed to: mitigated. P0 -> investigating -> mitigated.

oncall-amber: handing off to SRE rotation lead @sre_dan for postmortem drafting. I'm removing myself from pager for followups.

sre_dan: will draft RCA in /incidents/2026-03-15-eu-oom-sampling and include timeline, evidence, config diffs, and follow-ups. tagging Kate for observability gaps section.

observability-kate: will add dashboard corrections: expose per-host ingestion metric, add an alert when ingestion drops >80% for 1m, and add a playbook step for sampling rollbacks.

noncall-amber: thanks everyone. closing thread once RCA doc link posted. :thumbsup:
